endpoint.title: Valhalla endpoint URL
endpoint.description: Base URL of the Valhalla server. Defaults to Stadia Maps (https://api.stadiamaps.com), which needs an API key below. Leave blank to use the default, point at a self-hosted service resolved via the `valhalla` capability, or set another Valhalla-compatible host.

apiKey.title: Valhalla API key
apiKey.description: API key appended as `?api_key=` to requests. Required for Stadia Maps (free non-commercial tier); leave blank for key-less self-hosted instances. Set it here in the admin panel or via INTEGRATION_ROUTING_VALHALLA_APIKEY.

steps: Sign up at client.stadiamaps.com/signup (free, no credit card).
Open the dashboard and click 'Manage Properties'.
Select your property from the dropdown.
Under Authentication Configuration, generate your API key and copy it.
x-openmapx-setup.cost: Free tier: 200,000 credits/month, no credit card.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Only needed for the hosted Stadia Maps default; self-hosted Valhalla needs no key. Stadia's free tier is non-commercial / evaluation use only.

bidirectional-alternates.title: Traffic-aware alternates
bidirectional-alternates.description: Ask Valhalla for bidirectional route search on immediate driving trips so alternate routes are returned below the 500 km time-dependent threshold, and request a traffic-free duration for comparison. Turn off to restore single-route behaviour without a redeploy. Also settable via INTEGRATION_ROUTING_VALHALLA_BIDIRECTIONAL_ALTERNATES.

dataSources.name: Valhalla
dataSources.notes: Self-hosted or other operator-configured Valhalla endpoint. Requests stay with the instance operator's chosen host. The core elevation API also sends route geometry coordinates and sampling parameters to its independently configured Valhalla height endpoint. Height responses do not identify the underlying DEM; routing-engine MIT and OSM notices do not establish DEM ownership.

dataSources.name: Stadia Maps
dataSources.notes: Hosted Valhalla, used only when no self-hosted or other endpoint is configured. Free tier requires an API key and is limited to non-commercial / evaluation use; commercial use needs a paid Stadia plan. The core elevation API may also request height samples for route geometry from Stadia Maps. Elevation attribution links to https://stadiamaps.com/attribution/ for original elevation data sources; height responses do not identify the selected underlying DEM.
